purpose: Teach: 安売り/値動き/外装/試用/贈呈/発案/損得/取り立て

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、安売り戦略には頼るな
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Direct eye contact. Slight weight on the verb—this is non-negotiable. Conversational but commanding, no room for misinterpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。株式の値動きを毎日確認しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm monitoring stock movement daily.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive cadence. Slight lean forward—showing readiness. Steady delivery, no hesitation. The tone of someone who has already done what was asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品の外装デザインを改良しろ
lines.en: Improve the exterior design of our new products.
lines.style: Purposeful, measured. The instruction lands cleanly. Not harsh—composed authority expecting competence. Brief pause before the directive, like marking a decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様向けに試用品を発送します
lines.en: Yes. I'll send trial units to our valued clients.
lines.style: Prompt, professional acknowledgment. Slightly faster tempo—already moving into action. The rhythm of someone confirming and moving forward simultaneously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様への贈呈品を選定しろ
lines.en: Select gifts for our key clients.
lines.style: Brief, expectant. Weight lands on the verb. Not demanding—trusting competence to follow. The tone of someone whose instructions are reliably executed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員発案の改善提案を集約しています
lines.en: Yes. I'm consolidating improvement proposals from the staff.
lines.style: Steady update tone. Slightly quieter than before—reporting progress, not performing. The comfortable rhythm of someone sharing what's already in motion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、損得を社員に教えるな、誠実さを教えろ
lines.en: Teach our staff integrity, not profit margins.
lines.style: Quieter, more deliberate than previous commands. A shift—this is principle, not procedure. Weight on both concepts, slight pause between them. This is what matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。売掛金の取り立てを丁寧にしております
lines.en: Yes. I've been careful and considerate in collecting receivables.
lines.style: Calm, measured closing statement. Soft confidence—showing the principle is already lived practice. Trailing slightly, as if completing a larger thought.
